# Portable Chromium runtime

The Windows portable package uses the Chromium build downloaded by Playwright 1.62.1: browser version 151.0.7922.34, revision 1234. Download URL: https://cdn.playwright.dev/builds/cft/151.0.7922.34/win64/chrome-win64.zip. Upstream source: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/. Chromium's BSD license is in `LICENSE`; additional third-party notices can be viewed at `chrome://credits` in the packaged browser.
